name: Chestnut wine
summary: Rượu hạt dẻ is a wine made from Trùng Khánh chestnut, one of the things the eastern road makes from its autumn nut.
howToEat: Look for it in Trung Khanh with the roasted nuts and the chestnut green rice.
where: Trung Khanh, on the eastern road.
